**Finding: Missing (medium severity) — TRANSITION**

The agreement has no post-termination transition or data return mechanism:

- **§ 3.5 (Effect of Termination)** is a single paragraph dealing only with Customer's accrued payment obligations and continuing charges under other Service Option Attachments.
- Searches for "transition", "delete", and "return" turn up nothing relevant — the only "return" hits are the IP indemnity (§ 8.1, requiring *us* to return Materials) and the signature block.
- **§ 14.18 (Data Protection)** covers only contact information processing, not return or deletion of our data.
- **§ 11.6** makes Customer solely responsible for all Content but gives no corresponding retrieval right.

This is materially adverse in a hosting deal where all of our Content sits in IBM's e-business Hosting Environment — on termination we would have no contractual right to get it back, and no deletion assurance.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** inserted a new paragraph after p0049 in § 3.5 giving (a) up to six months' transition assistance at IBM's then-current rates on request, (b) return/retrieval of all Content in a commonly used machine-readable format within thirty days, and (c) certified deletion thereafter. I anchored it in § 3.5 deliberately: § 14.2 (Survival) already lists Section 3.5, so the new obligations survive termination without any further amendment.

The comment flags our fallback (90 days of assistance, same 30-day export window) in case IBM pushes back on the six-month tail.
